quarterly_data.quarter: Magnachip Semiconductor press release: Magnachip Launches New 6th-Generation 600V SJ MOSFETs (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Introduced two new 6th-generation 600V Super Junction (SJ) MOSFETs designed for AI server power applications: RDS(ON) of 36mOhm and 37mOhm, an integrated gate-source Zener diode for ESD protection and a significantly smaller chip than the previous generation; the MMTB60R037G6FZVRH adds a Fast Recovery Body Diode for high-frequency power conversion, which the company says makes it well suited for AI server power supplies. Both come in a TOLL package with a Kelvin Source configuration; also aimed at EV charging, industrial power supplies and telecom infrastructure.
